remarks: If you're looking for a large track of land with all kinds of possibilities and plenty to offer this 97.6 acre parcel may be just what you've been looking for. Located in Genesee County NY in the town of Alexander this beautiful quiet breath taking property is available. Ten minutes south of Batavia on Beaver Rd find a driveway through a wooded section over a creek opening up into a 10 acre elevated agricultural field perfect for crop land, food plots, or a picture perfect setting for you're dream home. The property is mostly wooded with approx. 50 acres of rolling hard woods. The remainder of the property consist of a section of wet land covered with large cat tails along with a thick brush and inter mixed soft wood trees. this area serves as an excellent cover and bedding for deer. If you want to hunt,camp or just want to unwind and relax,this land has you covered. All gas minerals and timber rights convey. The property has a large amount of mature trees which could be logged for substantial income. Please don't walk the property without a licensed NY agent present. The property has electric, water, and cable at the road.
